transitions.notes: Records exact outputs, terms digest, evidence, and subject digest; cites any EpisodeCompletion; exact episode fence when an Episode is cited (R29) — a fenced/stale result stays an orphan diagnostic (gap note G24).

transitions.notes: A later Delivery for the same Pledge revision supersedes the prior submission (§9.5 state list) — gap note G24.

transitions.notes: Already performed disclosures and effects remain historical facts (§9.5).

transitions.authority: participant (R14): exact reviewer seat only (§14.8 Delivery/Review row)
transitions.notes: One immutable Review with outcome fulfilled | revision_requested | rejected | disputed; the Pledge transition is separate but in the same review transaction; no runtime or verifier authors acceptance, and verification never decides fulfillment (§9.5, §14.8).
